Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding tourism promotion areas in large counties.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tourism promotion areas; and amending RCW35.101.010.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35.101.010 and 2003 c 148 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Unless the context clearly requires otherwise, the definitions inthis section apply throughout this chapter. (1) "Area" means a tourism promotion area. (2) "Legislative authority" means: (a) The legislative authority of any county with a populationgreater than forty thousand but less than one million, or of any cityor town within such a county, including unclassified cities or townsoperating under special charters; or (b) The legislative authority of any city or town within a countywith a population of one million or more, including unclassified citiesor towns operating under special charters, that has been selectedaccording to an interlocal agreement entered into by three or morecities or towns pursuant to chapter 39.34 RCW to establish a tourism p. 1 SHB 3035promotion area that includes within its boundaries portions of eachcity's or town's jurisdiction. (3) "Lodging business" means a person that furnishes lodgingtaxable by the state under chapter 82.08 RCW that has forty or morelodging units. (4) "Tourism promotion" means activities and expenditures designedto increase tourism and convention business, including but not limitedto advertising, publicizing, or otherwise distributing information forthe purpose of attracting and welcoming tourists, and operating tourismdestination marketing organizations.
